reason: The 32-replication aggregate report averages bins while its event log may expose only one replication. Separate one-replication runs observe each selected count and timeline directly.
exact_seed_delta: From the frozen aggregate A08.var05 input, set Control.NREPS 32 to 1, Control.RSEED to the seed number as a string, and ProblemDescription.PDESC to a seed-specific label. Every other row and table stays unchanged.
execution: One session-0 SSH batch holds Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue for all 32 seeds and checks GUI PID 13340 before and after every native step.

Each seed has an immutable run subdirectory with copied input, import/export/calc/report files, exact 14-table source roundtrip, per-step record and raw SHA-256 seals. The batch seals source hashes before and after.
Any failed command, missing output, changed source or GUI, absent seed or roundtrip mismatch fails the batch.
predeclared_acceptance: All 32 seeds convert with zero errors and classified warnings; each report has NREP=1 and 72 aligned half-hour bins.

Each event log realizes either one or five missions, both counts occur in the matrix, and starts follow 8+12*k/n for k=0..n-1 for realized n. Each mission succeeds and completes two hours after its start, with no cancellation, failure, repair or stock demand.

Each report integrates exactly 2n aircraft operation-hours and ends with three ready aircraft. Count mean, sample variance and nominal two-sided Student-t half-width use one observation per seed and target at most one mission half-width.
Seed 1 may be compared with the aggregate exposed log only as an observed same-seed check; distinct runs are not conflated.
An independent read-only reviewer replays manifest, generated inputs, source and raw hashes, event groups, statistics and ledgers without importing author validation.
limits: The 32 seeds are a fixed convenience matrix, not a random sample of seed values; observed counts cannot prove the specified 0.5/0.5 law or RNG independence.
Other integer distribution forms, zero count, GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
